summary: Current window/repository must be AlembicPlugin. Read parent AGENTS.md, this state root, accepted CO-5A and CO-5B controller decisions/results, AlembicPlugin AGENTS.md, and the AlembicCore CO-5B fixture surface at commit 377ecb4. Work only in AlembicPlugin. CO-5C is a consumer test/config migration package, not a production runtime refactor and not a Core deletion task. Starting from CO-5B, migrate AlembicPlugin residual test/config consumers away from transitional/retired Core routes where behavior can stay identical: @alembic/core/core/analysis, @alembic/core/core/ast/lang-*, @alembic/core/core/discovery, and @alembic/core/project-intelligence should move to @alembic/core/test-fixtures when CO-5B exports cover the symbol or helper. Expected targets include but are not limited to config/core-import-boundary-allowlist.json, test/unit/CallGraphAnalyzer.test.ts, test/integration/RealProjectBootstrap.test.ts, test/integration/GoSupport.test.ts, test/integration/RealProjectEnhancement.test.ts, test/integration/RealProjectAst.test.ts, test/integration/RealProjectDiscovery.test.ts, test/integration/RealProjectLanguage.test.ts, test/integration/PanoramaIntegration.test.ts, and project-intelligence residual unit tests such as CouplingAnalyzer, MultiLanguageParsers, ProjectIntelligenceIncrementalPlanner, LayerInferrer, FileDiffSnapshotStore, PanoramaService, LanguageServiceDetect, ProjectAnalysisMaterialization, RoleRefiner, CustomConfigDiscoverer, PanoramaAggregator, PanoramaScanner, and ModuleDiscoverer. If a symbol is not covered by @alembic/core/test-fixtures or migration would change tested behavior, leave the residual import in place with an exact blocker and updated allowlist reason instead of inventing a mock or editing Core. Do not edit vendor/AlembicCore, Alembic, AlembicAgent, plugin marketplace/release snapshots, tool schema semantics, production runtime files, or source behavior outside test/config migration. Do not delete Core routes, reintroduce @alembic/core/project-intelligence package exports, change KnowledgeService aliases, move service/quality or service/bootstrap, or reclassify RecipeContext unused kinds. Required work: 1) record pre-change git status and focused rg counts for the old specifiers and @alembic/core/test-fixtures; 2) migrate imports to @alembic/core/test-fixtures with behavior-preserving symbol replacements; 3) update config/core-import-boundary-allowlist.json counts/reasons to reflect current residuals, aiming for zero residuals only when raw rg proves it; 4) run focused tests for touched files plus build/lint/boundary checks; 5) return a TargetResultEnvelope with commit hash, changed files, exact old-route residuals, validation output, risks, and whether the remaining residuals block a later Core export shrink package. Verification expected before result: pre/post git status; focused rg scans for @alembic/core/core/analysis, @alembic/core/core/ast/lang-, @alembic/core/core/discovery, @alembic/core/project-intelligence, and @alembic/core/test-fixtures; npm run build:check; focused vitest for touched tests; npm run lint; npm run lint:repo-boundary; npm run build or clear reason if build:check is the repo's accepted seam; git diff --check and git diff --cached --check. Run plugin smoke/session/distribution only if production runtime, tool schema, package export, or release asset surfaces are touched; otherwise explicitly state why not. If migration requires production-code changes, sibling edits, Core changes, or user decisions, stop and return blocked/needs-controller with evidence.
